steps.solution_code:
import random

secret = random.randint(1, 10)
guess = int(random.randint(1, 10))
print("비밀 숫자: " + str(secret))
print("추측: " + str(guess))

import random

secret = random.randint(1, 10)
guess = int(random.randint(1, 10))
attempts = 0

while guess != secret:
    attempts = attempts + 1
    if guess < secret:
        print("비밀 숫자가 추측보다 커요!")
    else:
        print("비밀 숫자가 추측보다 작아요!")
    guess = int(random.randint(1, 10))

attempts = attempts + 1
print("정답! " + str(attempts) + "번 만에 맞췄어요!")
